make-a-new-agent-one-builder.txt.what: The reference process "make a new agent" (ref/dev/make-a-new-agent v3), as published, with its blanks filled and nothing else changed. Every new agent runs it: one builder (your coding harness with the ADLC plugin, or your own coding assistant on a pull request) holds build-the-agent, from the approved spec through the code, in one build folder whose own ADLC check judges the build.
make-a-new-agent-one-builder.txt.from: CommonAgent/common-agent-standards, branch processes/two-phases, processes/reference/make-a-new-agent.md (Make a new agent v3, Agent Processes 0.10.2, published at https://agentprocesses.ai/make-a-new-agent.html once it is live)

make-a-new-agent-one-builder.txt.version_3: v3 of the reference (2026-11-12): the builder writes the architecture record, the agent's own files, the suite and the scripts in any order, and a check it cannot change judges them together. The suite is shown to fail against an empty stand-in for every script, and once the scripts are first judged against it, it cannot change. The goal, build-the-agent, one handoff, the policy and one record say so. A build started on v2 keeps its own copy and finishes on it.

rebuild-from-as-built-record.txt.what: Product Factory's own process for a build started from an as-built record (stages.json 1.5.0, the starting point as-built-record): the reference "make a new agent" v1 with its trigger, goal, three writing phases, one handoff, data and its last policy reworded for an as-built record of code kept elsewhere, built again without taking that code on. Its phases, handoffs and deviations are the same as that document's: the reference spec writer, test writer and code writer hold its writing phases.
rebuild-from-as-built-record.txt.from: https://agentprocesses.ai/make-a-new-agent.html (ref/dev/make-a-new-agent v1), fetched 2026-11-08, with its blanks filled for a build on one computer
rebuild-from-as-built-record.txt.reworded_for_the_spec: stages.json 1.6.0: Requirements hands back the spec, and the agent's own files are made from it. Two places said the package is made from the spec, as if the spec were the agent's own files; they now say the package is made from the agent's own files, which the spec writer makes from the spec: the make-the-package phase, and the approve-the-spec -> make-the-package handoff. No phase, handoff key or deviation changed. adopt-existing-code.txt carries the same two changes.
